name: Scorebug Live
subtitle: Stream volleyball with a score
promotionalText: Put the game on YouTube with the score on screen. Film from one iPhone, keep score from the same phone, an Apple Watch or a second phone in the stands.
description:
Scorebug streams your volleyball matches to YouTube with a live scoreboard on the video. Set an iPhone on a tripod courtside, tap Go Live, and family who couldn't make it watch every point with the score on screen.

FILM AND STREAM FROM ONE IPHONE
• Go live on your team's YouTube channel in a couple of taps
• The scoreboard is drawn onto the video itself, so it's there on every screen
• Share the watch link with a tap
• Every match is also recorded on the phone, in 1080p or 4K, to keep or share later
• Not streaming today? Record only, with the score still kept

KEEP SCORE THE WAY THAT WORKS FOR YOU
• Tap the left or right side of the screen while you film
• Score from your wrist with the Apple Watch app
• Hand scoring to a second phone in the stands: show the QR code, they scan it and score. No account needed for a scorer
• Undo, swap sides, and set point and match point checks before a set ends

BUILT FOR YOUTH AND CLUB VOLLEYBALL
• Best of 3 or 5, with the deciding set to 15
• Team names, short names and colors on the scoreboard, in the style you pick
• Invite coaches and parents to your team so anyone can film or score
• Broadcasts are unlisted: people with the link can watch

WHAT YOU NEED
• An iPhone and a tripod
• A Google account to sign in
• A YouTube channel with live streaming turned on (YouTube can take up to 24 hours to turn it on the first time)
• An Apple Watch is optional

Scorebug is free. Questions? Visit scorebug.live/support.
